newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Belle signs accord with casino firm.
newsitem.headline: Belle signs accord with casino firm.

text.p: Gaming firm Belle Corp said on Monday it had signed a memorandum of agreement with the state Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corp (Pagcor) on a project to set up what it said will be one of the world's biggest casinos.
Belle said in a statement it plans to develop a 4.6 hectare site on reclaimed land in Manila Bay into a commercial, residential and leisure complex.
Part of the development would be leased to Pagcor for use as a casino.

"The corporation will lease 15,000 sq metres of floor area for Pagcor's use as a casino, making it one of the largest casinos in the world," corporate secretary Bayani Tan told the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The complex will house a hotel, a shopping mall, restaurants, entertainment areas and several residential towers.
The company earlier announced it was planning to build a racetrack in suburban Quezon city.
